---
title: "0008 Changelog format and versioning"
date: 2026-10-18
status: accepted
basis: reasoning
---

## Decision

`CHANGELOG.md` follows [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org). Each release lists its changes under four headings, in this order:

1. Breaking changes
2. New features
3. Bug fixes
4. Performance

The "Performance" heading is for significant optimizations, with the measured before and after numbers and a pointer to the benchmark.

Work in progress goes under `## Unreleased` and is renamed to the version number at release.

## Justification

The four headings were chosen by Jeffrey Wong. Putting breaking changes first tells a user immediately whether upgrading is safe. Performance gets its own heading because, for this library, speed and memory are features (decision [0006](0006-benchmarks-memray.qmd)).

Before 1.0.0, a breaking change bumps the minor version (0.1 → 0.2) and anything else bumps the patch version, as SemVer allows for `0.y.z`.
